capabilities: Scan vault-wide image references in three syntaxes, skipping code blocks
Detect duplicate images via SHA-256 hashing across local and cloud storage
Manage images on four hosts: Aliyun OSS, Tencent COS, GitHub, and SM.MS
Batch delete, copy Markdown/HTML links, and download images with confirmation
Sync image-host settings across devices over WebDAV with conflict detection
extras: Detailed image-host and WebDAV setup is kept in a separate CONFIG.md rather than the README. Credentials are stored encrypted with AES-GCM + PBKDF2. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to see which images are referenced, unreferenced, missing, or duplicated across a vault, especially when images live on external hosts.
